text:
Hanover’s median asking rent sits at 11.38 €/m², up 4.3 % year‑on‑year and 24.6 % over the past five years, placing the city 19th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The market is balanced, with a 2.2 % vacancy rate and 27 days on market, while 26 % of listings are let within a week.

Affordability remains tight: asking rents are 58 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 7.21 €/m², and a 60 m² apartment costs about 683 € per month, generating a rent‑burden of 15.3 % for two residents.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 12.04 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 11.72 €/m² and 12.33 €/m², a 5.8 % increase.
